notes.title: Sailing Content Patch out! — October 25th
notes.content:
Hello all!

Thank you for the wait on this one. Unfortunately my time working in Unveil has been greatly limited, but still was able to wrap this Content Patch and make it available for you all to enjoy, even if that meant cutting some corners, specifically in Free Roam new areas (not that many new ones -- sorry!).

[h1]The Changelog[/h1]

[list]
	[*][b]New Sailing activity:[/b] The major new feature! You may now construct a Raft to sail off on selected scenarios (Castaway & Free Roam) to live the life of a resource plunderer.[/*]
	[*][b]New Raft vehicle:[/b] A water vehicle that can be constructed at shoreline. Player may spend energy to row to increase speed, or sail when wind is good for free locomotion.[/*]
	[*][b]Raft Desalinator upgrade:[/b] Allows the raft to produce fresh water while the player is on board.[/*]
	[*][b]New Castaway Scenario: [/b]Sail your way out of a water-less island, visit islands to gather different kind of resources, and fish to gain enough energy to return to Mainland.[/*]
	[*][b]Controller:[/b] Fixed issue that would prevent the use of the correct game controller when multiple are detected by the OS, even if only one is connected.[/*]
	[*]Minor aesthetic fixes on Free Roam maps.[/*]
	[*]All pre-sailing scenarios have had their water surface limited to prevent the player falling off the edge of the sea. There are four elephants holding the map, and they are too shy to be seen.[/*]
	[*][b]Bridge construction:[/b] Fixed bug that prevented gap-bridges to be built on small spaces which are still viable building locations.[/*]
	[*]Lowered Tier 2 completion threshold from 3 scenarios down to 2 scenarios. Some users expressed their interest in being able to start Free Roam sooner.[/*]
[/list]

If you find any issues, please send an e-mail at pablo @ particle.com.ar

Thank you all for playing Unveil.

notes.title: Shelters Content Patch
notes.content:
The Shelters Content Patch is now available! Comes with several, very important bug fixes, as well as two new items -- because you guys were vocal you wanted shelters!


[h1]Leafy Parasol[/h1]
Build a Parasol to protect from sun and rain. Upgrade it to collect water into an existing water container, and repair it after weather wears it down. On normal weather conditions, a Parasol lasts for about a year without repair.

[h1]Leafy Wind Breakers[/h1]
Build wind breakers to protect from wind. These last less than parasols and are worn out more by wind, but are cheaper to setup and repair.


[h1]Full patch notes:[/h1]

[list]
	[*][b]New Parasol construction:[/b] Build a Leafy Parasol that shelter from Rain and Sun Light.  It will wear out the harsher the weather is.  It can be repaired using some materials to patch it up.  It can be salvaged to obtain some of it's components, although less are obtained the more damaged it is.  Parasols can be upgraded with extra modules or modifications.[/*]
	[*][b]Parasol 'Water Collector' upgrade:[/b] Parasols can have a Water Collector built in, which allows the roof to collect water down to a container. A container must be set in place first to collect water.[/*]
	[*][b]Free Roam mountain area:[/b] Fixed an issue stitching contiguous maps, skipping one map completely, and allowing users to enter the old Free Roam scenario through a cave. Thank you Natureguy for the detailed report![/*]
	[*][b]LEGENDARY BUG FIX:[/b] Solved issue on which savefiles would grow endlessly in size. This was due to infinitely creating new instances of objects when staring at them on world view, but were never removed from the item registry, as they never actually became part of the Gain / Loose circuit. Thank you Natureguy for providing the savefiles required for this fix.[/*]
[/list]


That is all for now. Make sure to report any issues to support @ particle.com.ar  (no white spaces) for immediate assistance. Once the patch is proven to be stable, I'm off working on the next one. It is going to be great.

Thank you everyone for playing Unveil all this time. Happy surviving!

- Pablo Neirotti

notes.title: Developer update — June patch: Shelters
notes.content:
Hello all!

I am back from my vacations. My mind is now clear, and my creativity tank is refilled, ready to bring you some cool new updates to the game, many of which are based on your suggestions.

On June we will be releasing our first Content Patch post-release, just like we did during the Early Access times.

This one is comes with several adjustments, bug fixes, and: Shelters!

You may construct a Leafy Parasol to protect from sun and rain, as well as a Leafy Wind Breaker to protect from rain. This is a very cool, modular approach to shelter building.

You may repair or salvage these shelter constructions at any time. Plus, the Leafy Parasol will launch with one upgrade: Water Collector - allowing water to be collected on a provided container off rain. Pretty much like putting an Open Container down on the floor, except this is much faster, and the contents won't evaporate due to sun heat once rain stops.


[h1]Get early access to the Shelters Content Patch[/h1]

Send an e-mail to  support @ particle.com.ar  (no white spaces) requesting to participate on the Shelters Beta. You will be given access sometime in June, a week before release, so you can test the new stuff and help finding any issues before releasing to everyone.


That is all for today. Expect more news on this during June. Big thanks to everyone for playing Unveil and dying hundreds of times.

- Pablo Neirotti

notes.title: Bugspray and Balancing of May 2nd
notes.content:
Hey guys!

I really appreciate you taking the time to provide feedback for Unveil. That has generated some well needed balance changes, which you can experience today.

This is the full patch notes for today:

[list]
	[*][b]Rocks Actions:[/b] The cost for various Rock actions have been reduced, mainly in the Crack Open and Salvage department. Now more than ever using a Sharp Stone to open Coconuts is a great energy saver.[/*]
	[*][b]Pain Training:[/b] Major balance and map layout update, to make Energy easier to obtain, while also ensuring the player is constantly dealing with injuries. This was done to make it easy to experiment with the various tools to deal with injury-related mechanics without worrying about the rest.[/*]
	[*][b]Fishing Time:[/b] Minor balance and map layout changes. This was done to ensure players find the lake at north, as well as adding a bit of starting Fat, so they have enough energy to do some basic stuff before dying if they already caught a fish to eat. At the same time, this won't be extending death for too long if the player does not have a fish and it is already too late to do that.[/*]
	[*][b]Cold Training:[/b] Added a couple more Berry Bushes, to make sure players have enough Energy to focus on the Scenario objectives.[/*]
	[*][b]Bandages:[/b] Changed recipe from 3 Big Leaves + 1 Vine to only 3 Big Leaves. This was done to make the item easier to craft right away, and also match the icon better. Yes, making sense matters.[/*]
	[*][b]Machetes:[/b] Increased total uses from 50 to 80.[/*]
	[*][b]Weather:[/b] More adjustments to prevent cloud loss during draught, so that it eventually rains again.[/*]
	[*][b]Mortar and Pestle:[/b] Updated crafting recipe for this item, which was legacy. It now, as it should, costs zero energy to craft, and requires a Wooden Bowl and a Long Rock.[/*]
[/list]


Happy surviving!

- Pablo Neirotti

notes.title: Developer Log: April Update + April 29th patch notes
notes.content:
Hello guys!

I am glad to bring you a wrap up of the Unveil Full Version release on Steam, many callouts, update on the current state and future plans.

Find all of that, with timestamp in the description, in the video below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qxkWy2zwWrQ

[h1]April 29th patch notes[/h1]

[list]
	[*][b]Tree chopping:[/b] Readjusted effectiveness of axes for a lower Energy consumption when chopping trees down. The Improvised Axe should require 30 Energy to chop one down, while the regular Axe should require 24 Energy. This was done due to many critical survival elements being bound to Wood Logs, and the cost was set too high specially for starting situations.[/*]
	[*][b]Carving Wooden Bowls:[/b] Now carving a Wood Log to obtain a Wooden Bowl will result in obtaining two instead of one. Also reduced cost from 10 Energy to 8 Energy. This was due the high cost of crafting the wooden bowl, making it a rare item to use most of the times. Hopefully this way we bring it back to a reasonable cost and value. [/*]
	[*][b]New Free Roam starting location "Rocky Hills":[/b] Start slightly north of the desert between the Twigged Forest (east) and Swampy Muds (west). A starting area that leads directly into the mountain section of the land.[/*]
	[*][b]Map Information HUD:[/b] Added icon to indicate if the area has more or less air humidity than the average. Also adjusted how intensities are calculated, for more reliable display of these.[/*]
	[*][b]Savegames:[/b] Fixed bug (dragged from RPG Maker foundations???) on which Playtime would only display the last session, but not total. Time not tracked so far has been lost, but it new playtime will count towards total playtime in the save from now on.[/*]
	[*][b]Ground holes:[/b] Now these will have water raise at different speeds depending on the soil type (grassy, dry, sand).[/*]
	[*]Minor stability fixes.[/*]
	[*][b]Climbing:[/b] Removed the "Let's do this!" and "Phew!" modal dialogs (those that require a key press to continue), making it smoother to climb up and down. The last message will still display as a non-modal speech bubble on top of the character.[/*]
[/list]

EDIT: Forgot to push changes regarding climbing. Added at the very end.


That is all for now. Thank you guys for your support so far! Expect more content after I am back from my vacations during May. There is a long way to go, and tons of features that would fit just great in Unveil.

Happy surviving!

- Pablo Neirotti

notes.title: Massive Lag Bugspray
notes.content:
Hello all!

Thanks to your reports, we got a few fixes coming your way. This may not represent all of the issues reported, but definitely tackle the most urgent and easiest ones:

[list]
	[*][b]Massive lag - Epic bug fix:[/b] Solved issue that would exponentially increase the amount of objects in memory and in save game, causing massive lag. savefiles 100 times larger, and eventual game crash due to lack of memory. A script will automatically repair any affected saved games. Thanks DaBenshi for reporting this.[/*]
	[*][b]Disappearing objects when dropping on ground:[/b] Solved issue that could cause objects dropped on the ground to disappear if the player was walking towards an existing object on the ground that isn’t a Pile of Items.[/*]
	[*][b]Important events properly cancel activities:[/b] Properly cancels all current activities and interactions before playing an important event such as Faints and Death. Thanks to Danielle L. for reporting this.[/*]
[/list]

Some other minor issues won't be fixed until Release patch.

If you find any other issue, report away! The sooner we get them fixed, the sooner we'll have a smooth survival experience.

Send them by e-mail ( http://unveilgame.com/support/ ) to speed up the process.

Happy surviving!

- Pablo Neirotti

notes.title: Adventures: Sickness and Campfire bugspray
notes.content:
Hello guys!

Past the smaller patches pushed during last week, fixing some Adventures Content Patch bugs, found here as comments:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/375210/announcements/detail/758092451868627286

... There are some few issues solved on this patch, worth a new Announcement on it's own. So here we go!

[list]
	[*][b]Automatic unstuck:[/b] The game will periodically ensure the player isn’t stuck in a tile, for reasons that escape my ken, and barbie too. Shall the player be stuck, it will be moved to the nearest adjacent tile, including diagonals.[/*]
	[*][b]Item Sickness on Inventory view:[/b] The item inspector will now display the total sickness obtained by eating the whole unhealthy item, based on how much it weights, as opposed to displaying the amount per kilogram, which was not clear and unintended.[/*]
	[*][b]Sickness time stacking:[/b] Fixed issue that would cause Sickness to always reset to around an hour when induced by ingesting unhealthy food, as opposed to stacking time.[/*]
	[*][b]Sickness max duration:[/b] Increased max duration from 2 days to 3 days. This is done to encourage the use of Wellness Soups.[/*]
	[*][b]Campfire:[/b] Fixed issue on which campfires would remain lit visually, although fire was out in the simulation, when fire was put out abruptly (caused by use of many piles of dirt).[/*]
[/list]

Thank you everyone for reporting these issues. You are really helping Unveil become a great and stable experience for everyone at launch.

Ensure to restart Steam for the update to kick in.

Happy surviving!

notes.title: Progression Bugspray
notes.content:
Hello guys!

As always, some stuff break after a big change, code-wise, as a Content Patch is. Today we fix that, as well as some stuff that still needed some attention.

[h1]Issues equipping an item?[/h1]
This bug has been fixed, but items already crafted are still affected. Scenario restart (or crafting a new one) is required.

[h1]Lost your progress?[/h1]
Noticeable when Free Roam becomes disabled, as if you've never unlocked anything.
A third security layer has been added to prevent game data from corrupting when incorrectly closing the game (pressing the X on the top right of the window).

[b]To recover your progress:[/b] get the Beta Tools Package, available at [url=http://unveilgame.com/packages/#downloads]Packages Download on Unveil's Website[/url]. This will let you unlock scenarios you had before.
- Download the Beta Tools package.
- Follow the instructions on the webpage to install it in Unveil's Packages directory.
- Open Unveil
- Go to Play > Custom Scenarios > Beta Tools
- Walk to the top. Each button will tell you what Scenario they will mark as completed once interacted with.

Hopefully there are no more progression losses after this security patch. If still happens to you, [b]please report this to us[/b] on the website's contact section or these forums.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*]Removed Free Roam from the Scenarios selection screen. Don’t worry, something tells me Tiny Island won’t be feeling lonely for too long.
[*]Added a third security layer to writing Account and Game Saves files for even less chance of corrupted data. Exiting through in-game menus is still advised over abruptly terminating it by closing the window.
[*]Fixed issue on which some data wouldn’t be loaded back into the game, causing the game to crash.
[*]Fixed bad alignment on the Clothing sheet for Item Inspector.
[*]Added buffer time to Account Saving, to prevent saving it too many times in a row. This was donde to increase the stability and reliability of Account Saving, reducing even more so chances of progression loss due to corrupted files.
[*]Fixed issue that causes some items (mainly clothing) crafted without this patch, to be impossible to equip.
[/list]

notes.title: Extend: Content Patch — Modding comes to Unveil
notes.content:
Hello guys!

It is finally happening. It is finally time. Extend goes live, bringing several bugfixes, more music, and most importantly, enabling Unveil to be modded by anyone in the community, with a very streamlined and comprehensive online documentation.

Learn more about Modding and what comes in Extend Content Patch, in the following video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bmnlSzSmxiE

More info in video's description.


[h1]Changelog[/h1]

And as always, it all wouldn't feel complete without a detailed list of what is new. So here we go!
[list]
[*]Created documentation for most things moddable in the game, found at http://unveil.gamepedia.com/Modding
[*]Added Packages support to Unveil, allowing external content to be injected into the game.
[*]New! Additional Ambient music for all climatic situations.
[*]Speech bubbles: New centered design to allow almost twice as much text when needed.
[*]Thought bubble: New! Made specially for Storytelling for modders. Now a thought bubble can be used for secondary thoughts or alternate characters.
[*]Roots Scenario: Complete revision based on user feedback. The scenario should be more straightforward, preventing non intended failures, teaching better water level changes, and making it more clear on the possible ways out of the forest.
[*]Fixed issue that would allow discontinued items to be obtained from digging.
[*]Removed some discontinued Scenarios.
[*]Fixed UI bug that would cause the game to crash while Fishing.
[*]Free Roam Scenario: Added Rabbits closer to a starting location that is otherwise virtually impossible to survive on.
[*]Fixed issue on which trees hit by a lighting and then harvested, would blink on and off.
[*]Fixed issue that could cause the Campfire to emit a huge, square light. This lightning module is so buggy T_T. Hopefully it is finally stable.
[*]Now the correct Tileset according to water level will load immediately when switching from or to a cave, ensuring each display their water-bound terrain properties accordingly.
[*]Performance: Added proper cleanup for unused Audio Mixers that would pile up indefinitely. This could be the main cause of performance issues for some users. Awaiting feedback.
[*]Black screens: Applied patch that should allow users who deactivated Steam Overlay to turn it back on without issues. Awaiting feedback.
[*]Added Unveil Terminal executable for easier live Modding logging.
[/list]

notes.title: Enhance Bugspray 4 — AMD Inventory
notes.content:
Phew! Four very bad days until I finally got around fixing the Inventory issue some AMD users were experiencing. Rebuilding the whole Inventory from scratch did the job. Yes. That. I am so glad it’s done!

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Inventory: Rebuilt Inventory UI which was crashing on some AMD users. Big thanks to Valisor for being a test subject for this issue.
[*]Maps: Updated many maps which could prevent the player from entering or leaving a cave. Thank you FoxInShadow for reporting this.
[*]Scenario completion: Fixes to the way text was being written, which looked cropped or off place.
[*]Executable: Replaced current executable with one without a console. That was a mistake from when I compiled a new version with a small nVidia fix.
[*]Debugging: Added few new internal tools to help me aid users faster in the future.
[*]Fishes: Readjusted breeding to prevent fishes going extinct on their own.
[/list]

Once the game is stable again, I will continue working towards the next Content Patch.

All Content Patches are critical in the development towards the final product. There are many to come down the road.

For now, if you have any more issues with Enhance's new engine, please make a report at the Support & Bug report section!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/375210/discussions/1/541907675758250646/

Thank you everyone for your support. Have a good evening!

- Pablo Neirotti

[b]Receive content patch announcements by e-mail![/b]

[b]Help us build the Unveil wiki at Curse's Gamepedia![/b]
http://unveil.gamepedia.com/

[*]Engine: Now Steam Overlay is supported in game.
[*]Engine: LEGENDARY FIX: F12 does not reset the game anymore.
[*]Engine: Dropped support of in-game Screenshots. You can now take them using Steam Screenshots by pressing F12.
[*]World Items: Improved underlying World Items deployment system to reduce chance of maps breaking when it’s contents gets modified in a patch (only applies to new saves after this patch).
[*]World Items: LEGENDARY BUG FIX - Redone relinking system to prevent World Items to appear in weird spots, or look like other items, or simply not work when coming back to an existing map.
[*]Engine: New Particles system with Emitters, Sub Emitters and Particles.
[*]Visual Effects: Floating sparkles for indicating wind speed are now Particle based.
[*]Sim Units: Campfires now use Emitters for fire and smoke, as a 1:1 representation of the flame size and fuel burnt. Smoke displacement is affected by local wind speed. Vapor will start to come out if local humidity is high enough.
[*]Visual Effects: Rain impact on the ground is now displayed visually through a Particle Emitter.
[*]Title Screen: Whole new title screen, now also with Credits.
[*]Items: Corrected descriptions too long for the Item Inspector box.
[*]Engine: Unified method for inspecting World Items. Now all items get benefited with automatic live updates of their stats when interacting with them, as time flows.
[*]Items: New item! Humidity Condenser. Will slowly turn air humidity into water. Requires humid air to function.
[*]Water Containers: Fixed issue on which filling a container would replace the amount of water in it, as opposed to adding to it.
[*]Water Containers: Can now be refilled at Humidity Condensers and Holes.
[*]Water Containers: Will now notify amount refilled and % full when refilled.
[*]Scenarios: Added support for some scenarios to have multiple possible starting locations.
[*]Settings: Added Scaling Method setting for upscaling pixels. Use Crisp for sharp pixel edges, or Smooth for blurried, softer pixel edges. Defaults to Crisp.
[*]Wind feedback: Updated Air Sparkles, HUD Wind Indicator, Music and Sound Effects to more accurately represent the current speed of wind.
[*]Notifications: Fixed issue that would display weights in KG with more than 1 comma decimal, which is the intended behavior.
[*]Tiles: Corrected many issues in order to display the correct interactions depending on the tile features.
[*]Water Containers: Now accumulated will evaporate by sun exposure, relative to the received sun heat (affected by shadowy areas).
[*]Notifications: Fixed font size to better fit the box on some notification types.
[*]Cactus: Fixed issues that would make harvested Cactuses look like ready to harvest.
[*]Title screen: Custom made Title Screen music! by Adam Halpin.
[*]Settings: Added Dynamic Shadows setting. This allows lower end computer users to uncheck this effect for an important performance boost when multiple light sources are on. Feature added upon Walter Cejas feedback.
[*]Weather: “OMG SO SORRY” BUG FIX. Weather Events weren’t triggering since probably Early Access launch. Now they will trigger properly.
[*]Weather: Added visual indicator for Current Weather Event when opening to Top Menu, including a progress bar of it’s duration.
[*]Wind Indicator: New wind indicator with a tight 1:1 representation of the wind blow. It’s rotation is now drawn dynamically, since the new engine allows it.
[*]Campfire: LEGENDARY BUG FIX. Solved issue on which a campfire my turn itself off when switching maps or loading a save game.
[*]Rain splashes: Will now only impact the ground on areas without ceiling.
[*]Rain sound effects: Polished audio levels.
[*]Sound Effects: LEGENDARY BUG FIX (omg I am on fire!). Solved issue on which some background sound effects like wind or rain wouldn’t be able to play again once stopped.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your support so far. It is a pleasure to deliver new stuff for such an awesome group of people.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Status update of July 8th
notes.content:
Hello guys!

I wanted to give you a heads up of what is going on behind the scenes.

After Cold Training was published, I had this itch. No, in my head. So at 1:30 AM I jumped out of the bed for a quick night time coding and started playing with things.

The day after, Friday, I finally succeeded to make the breakthrough I needed to make this really cool thing happen. I set out to repair the game (since that change destroyed a lot of it) and, now that is done, I am working full speed on taking advantage of that breakthrough.

I can't say exactly what will make it into the next Content Patch, coming in a week or two at most, but it is definitely something that all of you are going to love, for many different reasons.

At the same time, I will be revisiting Roots and Cold Training scenarios. I am getting a lot of feedback that they are really difficult and many simply cannot make it through. I want to ensure that everything meant to be learned is a challenge, but everything that is not, is instead offered for easy access to reduce the risk of failure for occurrences not relevant to the scenario's learning checklist.

That said, Unveil is all about true survival in nature. And it is meant to be hard.
If you are stranded, you don't mine a gold mine (chopping a tree down was already stretching it). You instead scout for anything that you may find useful, and use your super smart human brain to make the most out of it.

And also, I will be taking a look at quick ways to make the game more replayable in existing scenarios. I rather not use the cheap trick of Achievements just yet (although most people haven't found any of the easter eggs so far).

Back on track: even if you won't see new patches in the next week, I ask you for a little patience. The next Content Patch will most certainly surprise you.

Thank you everyone for your kind words, support, and great reviews on the Store page. And for understanding this is not just buying a game, but being part of the journey of making a pure survival in nature simulator.

Have a good evening!

- Pablo Neirotti

notes.title: Content Patch: Cold Training
notes.content:
Hello survivors of Unveil's Beta!

Today I am proud to announce you are getting the first Content Patch of Unveil, called "Cold Training".

Watch the video for more info about this Content Patch, future Content Patches, future features and enhancements:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dFXinMLj2FI

But as always, there is no patch without changelog, so here is the full list of changes. Worth reading!

[*]Scenarios: New Cold Training scenario. Survive 3 days in extreme cold to prove yourself and obtain the Cold Training token.
[*]Crafting: Now World Constructions (climbing vines, bridges...) will show all recipes available.
[*]Visuals: Now a slight tone adjustment is applied to the screen tone to reflect colder or hotter temperatures.
[*]Weather Simulation: Support of Astronomic Sun Angle, affecting both Heat and Photons reception on outdoor maps.
[*]System: Applied extra checks while saving to hopefully prevent "Errno::EACCESS - Permission denied” errors.
[*]System: Added support for auto-updating already created objects in game with latest item settings and values.
[*]Item Inspector: Improved readability of Wearables secondary page.
[*]Weareables: Rebalanced Dissipation and Sun Heat reductions.
[*]Flora simulation: Fixed issue that would freeze simulation for all flora in the map after four days.
[*]Crafting: New presentation of Crafted or Converted items.
[*]Items: Added High resolution version of some items.
[*]UI: Simulation will now pause while using the Top Menu.
[*]Placing items: Now when confirming deployment of item, it will skip the text, and display the correct item name on the top left corner (reported by Cristal).
[*]Cooking: Slightly reduced the amount of energy loss of food when cooking it (yes, food looses energy when cooked, it doesn’t gains more).
[*]Simulation: Environment now uses Sun Astronomical Light to define the actual Day and Night moments of the day (as opposed to a fixed time).
[*]Stability: Solved issue on which the game could crash when going hypothermic.
[*]Simulation: Fixed issue on which a Simulation Unit could reincarnate in a map object, even from another map. I am serious.
[*]Audio: Fixed issue on which ambient sounds would linger when going from indoor to outdoor and vice-versa.
[*]Slicing: Fixed issue that would crash the game when trying to slice an item (reported by DeltaCain and Eversor)
[*]Maps: Fixed Free Roam’s east forest map, where spawnables where stuck in queue due to lack of space to appear (reported by Dijinn and Galroche).
[*]Scenarios: Now Hot training has a two step objective chain. First will require the player to craft a Conical Leaf Hat, very useful to stand under strong sun rays, also leading to less hydration loss to sweating. Second Objective remains the same: be rescued by Rescue Crew on the third day.

Happy surviving!

notes.title: Patch: Faster animations + Tokens + More — Late June 24
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Today I was only gonna do some minor fixes but like usual, once I start coding things get out of hand.

Ensure to restart Steam to get the patch. It's about 20 MB in size.

So you are also getting a new feature!

Read all of these, this is a great patch:

[list]
[*][b]Settings: Animations.[/b] Use this feature to make animations slightly less smooth, but make the game more responsive. Make sure to set Graphic Quality to High, since it doesn't really have an impact on performance. But this will do!
[*]Maps: Fixed two maps that contained a tree or just sea, that may get the player stuck in them when switching maps.
[*]Maps: New! Now the system will attempt to relocate the player when switching maps and landing on an occupied tree (usually a tree). That way trying to ensure the player can move even if there is a map design flaw.
[*]Saving: Now the game won't autosave nor allow the player to save if stuck on an non-passable tile, even if virtually impossible now. This will let the player Exit and come back to the latest state on which it could move. [b]NAIL IN THE COFFIN FOR BUG[/b] :D
[*]Exit menu: Fixed bug that would crash the game when hitting the Menu key while on the Exit menu.
[*]Death procedure: Fixed issue that wouldn't delete a temporary save, causing an infinite death loop.
[*]Death procedure: Fixed issue that could crash the game when loading a Scenario on which the player was about to die.
[*]Tokens: Now Hot Training properly delivers a Hot Training token when completing it.
[*]Tokens: Tokens Manager will automatically grant Hot Training token to those who completed the scenario upon entering any Scenario.
[*]Tokens and Weareables: Fixed issue that wouldn't allow equipping Tokens or Wereables on a loaded game, that is, if the item wasn't obtained during that play session.
[/list]

I am working hard this week to kill (yes, kill) as many bugs as possible so we can later focus on the new content. Luckily the count is getting lower.

Thank you [b]so much[/b] to everyone taking the time to report these, and even allowing me to follow up with e-mails or chat to get this ironed out for yourselves but also everyone else.

notes.title: Patch: Faster animations + Tokens + More — Late June 24
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Today I was only gonna do some minor fixes but like usual, once I start coding things get out of hand.

Ensure to restart Steam to get the patch. It's about 20 MB in size.

So you are also getting a new feature!

Read all of these, this is a great patch:

[list]
[*][b]Settings: Animations.[/b] Use this feature to make animations slightly less smooth, but make the game more responsive. Make sure to set Graphic Quality to High, since it doesn't really have an impact on performance. But this will do!
[*]Maps: Fixed two maps that contained a tree or just sea, that may get the player stuck in them when switching maps.
[*]Maps: New! Now the system will attempt to relocate the player when switching maps and landing on an occupied tree (usually a tree). That way trying to ensure the player can move even if there is a map design flaw.
[*]Saving: Now the game won't autosave nor allow the player to save if stuck on an non-passable tile, even if virtually impossible now. This will let the player Exit and come back to the latest state on which it could move. [b]NAIL IN THE COFFIN FOR BUG[/b] :D
[*]Exit menu: Fixed bug that would crash the game when hitting the Menu key while on the Exit menu.
[*]Death procedure: Fixed issue that wouldn't delete a temporary save, causing an infinite death loop.
[*]Death procedure: Fixed issue that could crash the game when loading a Scenario on which the player was about to die.
[*]Tokens: Now Hot Training properly delivers a Hot Training token when completing it.
[*]Tokens: Tokens Manager will automatically grant Hot Training token to those who completed the scenario upon entering any Scenario.
[*]Tokens and Weareables: Fixed issue that wouldn't allow equipping Tokens or Wereables on a loaded game, that is, if the item wasn't obtained during that play session.
[/list]

I am working hard this week to kill (yes, kill) as many bugs as possible so we can later focus on the new content. Luckily the count is getting lower.

Thank you [b]so much[/b] to everyone taking the time to report these, and even allowing me to follow up with e-mails or chat to get this ironed out for yourselves but also everyone else.

[b]And one more time: If your game was running slow on your laptop, ensure you activate the "Faster" Animation setting, under Settings > Graphics > Animation.[/b]

Have a very good evening!

notes.title: Patch gone live: Humidity + Crafting — Late Night Jun 22
notes.content:
This is a summary of the late night patch, codenamed Humidity + Crafting.

[img]http://unveilgame.com/development/changelog/resources/2015-jun-22-crafting-details.jpg[/img]

[b]Legendary feature![/b] Because it has been requested for so long, but it wasn't until now I had the chance to do this right. Now, when trying to craft an item with missing ingredients, it will indicate which ingredients are missing.
						
[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Due to the Event Relinking fix, you need to restart your active Scenarios in order for the fix to work. This is highly advisable before moving forward with the current save (damage caused by this bug is irreversible, otherwise a proper migration would have been implemented).

[list]
[*][b]Legendary feature![/b] Now, when trying to craft an item with missing ingredients, it will indicate which ingredients are missing.[/*]				[*]Savegames: Added extra verifications to file saving to prevent an issue on which some players may get corrupted files. [u]Reported by Corydan Jade.[/u][/*]				[*]Savegames: Corrupted savefiles now will automatically be overwritten with a new playthrough if they cannot be recovered in any way.[/*]				[*]Maps: Corrected minor graphical glitches.[/*]				[*]Scenarios: Incremented availability of some resources at Hot Training and Free Roam.[/*]				[*]Fishing: Increased maximum weight of Fishing Rod from 1.2kg to 1.5kg.[/*]				[*]Wellness Coconut Soup: Reintroduced Elder Berries into the game, since most Scenarios didn't have these.[/*]				[*]Flora: Flora items will auto-update their position if spawning locations change between versions.[/*]				[*]Hydration: Reduced base dehydration rate (does not affect sweating) by 50% while sleeping, since the body enters a low consumption mode during that time.[u]Reported by Corydan Jade.[/u][/*]				[*][b]Legendary fix![/b] Resolved issue on which world items would look like other items (issues with Event <=> Simulation Unit relinking). Phew, I can't believe I solved this! It was haunting my dreams.[/*]				[*]System: Now the game will re-create missing Account and Screenshots folder on startup.[/*]				[*]Holes: Fixed issue on which it holes would use the same adjective twice to describe the size of a caught prey.[/*]				[*]Weather: [b]Massive readjustments[/b] on how Wind and Air Humidity relate to the rest of the Simulation, to increase air humidity on regular days.[/*]				[*]Simulation: Increased velocity of 2nd and 3rd simulation speeds.[/*]				[*]UI: Prevented Tools with only one action to go straight to the action (ha!). Now they forcefully show even a single action to perform, so that the Energy Cost can be displayed.[/*]				[*]UI: Faster, nicer center notification for Crafts and Time passing by.[/*]				[*]Graphics: Corrected overextending shadow of Small Tree.[/*]			[/list]
